content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Conventional platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy offer managed services: payment processing, product hosting, and delivery in exchange for fees and platform rules. They handle infrastructure for you but retain ultimate control. Sovereign stacks invert this model. You own the hosting (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers, Google Apps Script), order storage (Supabase, Google Sheets), and file delivery (Google Drive, Cloudflare R2). NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. The trade-off is clear: managed convenience versus infrastructure ownership. Conventional platforms are easier to start but restrict your autonomy. Sovereign stacks require initial setup but give you permanent control — no platform can shut you down or change terms unilaterally.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in only 46 countries, leaving 149 without access. PayPal restricts accounts in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, often suspending funds for months. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy follow similar geo-restrictions based on payment processor availability. Sovereign stacks bypass these limitations entirely. By using crypto payments through NOWPayments, you accept 300+ cryptocurrencies from any buyer globally. The stack runs on globally accessible infrastructure: GitHub Pages, Cloudflare, Supabase, and Google services. No single platform can block your operations. This is not a workaround — it's a structural alternative built at the base layer of the internet.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, with additional fees for currency conversion and chargebacks. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy add their own platform fees on top. NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee for crypto transactions, with no additional costs. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes, triggering automatic product delivery. Conventional platforms hold funds for days or weeks, with reserves and payout delays. Sovereign stacks give you instant access to funds and full control over your cash flow — no platform can freeze your revenue or change payout terms after deployment.
Stripe excludes 149 countries — sovereign stacks operate in all 195.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your customer data, payment history, and product delivery process. They can suspend your account or change terms at any time. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership of every component. Your store runs on your GitHub or Cloudflare account. Orders are stored in your Supabase database or Google Sheet. Files are delivered from your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 bucket. NOWPayments handles payments without storing buyer data. Automation is built into the stack: payment confirmation triggers instant product delivery via webhook. You retain full control over your infrastructure — no platform can access or alter your operations after deployment.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you need a quick solution and operate in a supported country, conventional platforms might suffice — but understand their limitations. If you're in a restricted region or value infrastructure ownership, sovereign stacks are the only permanent alternative. Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) for a GitHub Pages + Apps Script setup, or deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a Cloudflare + Workers + Supabase solution. Both stacks include NOWPayments integration, product loading, and end-to-end testing. Choose based on your technical comfort and scalability needs. Sovereign infrastructure is not a workaround — it's a deliberate choice to own your commerce stack instead of renting it from platforms that can exclude you at any time.

If Stripe is not available in your country, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a permanent solution. Deploy a stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This architecture bypasses geo-restrictions and gives you full ownership of your store. Recommended networks like BSC and Solana keep transaction fees under $0.10. Frequently Asked Questions
Can I accept payments from any country with a sovereign stack?

Yes. NOWPayments accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies from buyers in any country. Your stack runs on globally accessible infrastructure, so no region is excluded. Payment confirmation triggers instant product delivery via webhook.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments operates as a payment processor — your stack remains functional even if their service is temporarily unavailable. You retain full access to your hosting, backend, and order storage. Crypto payments can be re-routed to another processor if needed.
Do I need technical skills to deploy a sovereign stack?

Basic technical familiarity is helpful, but the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes full deployment and testing. You receive a fully operational store with 5 products loaded and 30-day support. The Blueprint ($47) provides complete documentation if you prefer self-deployment.
Can platforms like Stripe or PayPal shut down my sovereign stack?

No. Your stack runs on infrastructure you own: GitHub Pages, Cloudflare, Supabase, and Google services. No third-party platform can access or alter your operations. Crypto payments through NOWPayments are processed on-chain, outside any platform's control.
How do I handle refunds in a sovereign stack?

Refunds are processed manually by sending the equivalent crypto amount back to the buyer's wallet. Your order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets) tracks transactions, allowing you to verify and process refunds directly. No platform fees or restrictions apply.
Conventional platforms rent you infrastructure — sovereign stacks let you own it.
